sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma
 Order

By way of the present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of the FIR bearing No. 521/2018,
registered at Police Station Jaitpur, Delhi, for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC') and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom on the basis of settlement arrived at between the parties.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
3. The respondent no. 2 is not present before this Court.

4. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 on filing of process fee through all permissible modes, including electronically, returnable on the next date of hearing.
5. List on 13.02.2026.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/12/2025 at 20:50:32 6.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
